_comment: The Another World mod pack: the rule changes that make OB64: Another World play differently from the original game. Its options are set under its row in the MODS tab. docs/anotherworld/design-another-world-pack.md describes each part.
name: Another World
author: OB64: Another World
description: The class rebalance, Faerie heals and the Centurion command, shared battle EXP, class changes without alignment limits, and large units in one square.

options.name: SHARED EXP
options.help: A battle's EXP is pooled and shared across the unit, lower levels getting more. Every member keeps the levels it gained.

options.name: FAERIE HEALS
options.help: When an ally is below 70% HP, a Faerie's Throw a Kiss becomes Healing.

options.name: CENTURION COMMAND
options.help: Each Centurion that can still fight gives every Soldier on its side one more attack.

options.name: CLASS ALIGNMENT
options.help: IGNORED: class changes do not check alignment. VANILLA: the game's alignment limits.

options.name: LARGE UNITS
options.help: ONE SQUARE: a large class takes one place in a unit, for your units and the enemy's. VANILLA: two places.
